format: JavaScript (Node.js with ECMAScript Modules syntax, .mjs file)
description: This file is a script that performs static analysis on TypeScript source files to detect channel-agnostic boundary violations, such as improper imports, config references, and hardcoded channel identifiers. It defines functions to scan source content and reports violations of project boundaries related to channel-specific logic.

methods.name: findChannelAgnosticBoundaryViolations
methods.description: Analyzes the content of a source file to locate violations related to channel boundary violations, such as improper imports, config path references, and channel ID comparisons.

methods.name: findChannelCoreReverseDependencyViolations
methods.description: Checks for violations in channel core files where modules should not introduce channel-specific dependencies.

methods.name: findAcpUserFacingChannelNameViolations
methods.description: Detects user-facing text that references channel names, which should probably not be hardcoded in certain source files.

methods.name: findSystemMarkLiteralViolations
methods.description: Detects hardcoded system mark literals (like “⚙️”) in the source content.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Orchestrates the scan across all relevant files based on defined rule sets, reports violations, and enforces boundaries.
